episodes.synopsis: Takeru visits the peaceful world he originally came from to recover the research necessary for Alternative IV to be a success. Upon his return to the war-torn world ravaged by the BETA, he discovers a surprise that brings him one step closer to victory... and danger.
episodes.title: Graduation

episodes.synopsis: A new set of trials testing the combat readiness of Takeru's XM3 operating system takes a turn for the dangerous.
episodes.title: XM3

episodes.synopsis: After a soul-shaking brush with tragedy, Takeru decides to return to his home world.
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: With it now obvious that he's having unexpected effects on his peaceful home world, Takeru has to make a tough decision.
episodes.title: Diary

episodes.synopsis: Takeru returns to the world ravaged by the BETA, only to be shocked when Professor Kouzuki introduces him to 00 Unit.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: As Takeru grapples with the truth about the 00 Unit, a deadline to get it functional looms.
episodes.title: Sumika

episodes.synopsis: The A-01 Squad find that they will be part of a joint operation between the UN and Japan to attack the BETA hive on Sadogashima.
episodes.title: The Night Before the Attack

episodes.synopsis: The mission to retake Sadogashima is underway, and the Valkyries take to the battlefield.
episodes.title: Operation 21st

episodes.synopsis: The Susano-O arrives, and the outcome of Operation 21st will depend on the performance of the flying fortress.
episodes.title: The Light of Victory

episodes.synopsis: With the Susano-O inoperable, the Valkyries move to recover the 00-Unit as BETA continue to swarm Sadogashima.
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: A massive horde of BETA surfaces from beneath Sadogashima, putting the A-01 Task Force and success of Operation 21st in danger.
episodes.title: Inheritance

episodes.synopsis: After the mission on Sadogashima, there is a memorial service for the fallen soldiers. Shortly thereafter, it is revealed that Captain Isumi Michiru has also fallen...
episodes.title: The World Moves On
